name: Exp_CyclePeriod
summary: This EA trades based on the CyclePeriod custom indicator, which measures the dominant cycle period of price action. It opens buy positions when the cycle period value rises (shorter cycle = momentum accelerating upward) and sell positions when it falls, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CyclePeriod自定义指标进行交易，该指标测量价格行为的主导周期长度。当周期值上升时开多仓，周期值下降时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于CyclePeriod指标，该指标通过Alpha参数（0.07）平滑计算价格的主导周期长度。入场条件为：当指标值Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓，表示周期缩短、动量向上加速；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓，表示周期缩短、动量向下加速。出场条件依赖固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时在反向信号出现时平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损的自由保证金、扣除亏损的余额和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。策略使用新K线检测（IsNewBar）避免重复信号，并依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库封装交易逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the CyclePeriod indicator, which calculates the dominant cycle period of price action using an Alpha smoothing parameter of 0.07. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1], indicating a shortening cycle with upward momentum acceleration; a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1], indicating a shortening cycle with downward momentum acceleration. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), with additional position closing on opposing signals (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 risk ratio. The strategy uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to avoid duplicate signals and relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for trade execution logic.

pros: 使用周期分析作为交易信号来源，属于较少见的分析方法，具有独特性
提供五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活度高
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望收益的盈亏比设计
允许独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓，灵活性强
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Uses cycle period analysis as a trading signal source, which is a relatively uncommon approach with unique perspective
Provides five position sizing modes, offering high flexibility in money management
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2, designed with a positive expectancy risk-reward ratio
Allows independent control of buy/sell direction for both opening and closing positions, offering high flexibility
Implements new bar detection to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标CyclePeriod和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少内嵌逻辑，可移植性差
止损1000点和止盈2000点过大，在不同波动率环境下可能不适用
没有点差过滤、波动率过滤或交易时段过滤机制
代码中包含双分号（int median=5;;）和乱码注释，代码质量有待提升
缺少对已有持仓数量的检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator CyclePeriod and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are very large and may not suit all volatility environments
No spread filter, volatility filter, or trading session filter mechanisms
Code contains a double semicolon (int median=5;;) and garbled comments, indicating code quality issues
Lacks a check for existing position count, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率自适应止损止盈机制，使策略适应不同市场条件
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并添加最大持仓数限制
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit mechanisms to adapt the strategy to different market conditions
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction, and implement a maximum position count limit

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，在极端行情下单笔亏损可能非常可观
没有同方向持仓数量检查，可能在单方向积累过多仓位
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差时可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is very large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses in extreme market conditions
No position count check in the same direction, potentially accumulating excessive positions on one side
No spread filter, possibly executing at unfavorable prices during low liquidity periods
